company: Amazon.com, Inc. (AWS Lambda MicroVMs, part of Amazon Web Services)

ownership.quote: Lambda MicroVMs is an AWS Lambda serverless compute environment offering.

stage.quote: Amazon.com, Inc. is a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: AMZN); AWS is a reporting segment within Amazon's public filings.
stage.note: AWS Lambda MicroVMs is a feature/product line of AWS, not an independently funded entity; Amazon is a public company, so no separate funding rounds apply.

revenue.basis: AWS segment full-year 2024 net sales as reported in Amazon's Q4 2024 earnings release (Amazon.com, Inc. consolidated financials); figure is for the whole AWS segment, not the Lambda MicroVMs product specifically, whose standalone revenue is not broken out.
revenue.quote: AWS segment sales increased 19% year-over-year to $107.6 billion in 2024.

note: Not an independent company: AWS Lambda MicroVMs is a feature of AWS Lambda, itself a service of Amazon Web Services, a segment of the publicly traded Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN). No separate ownership, accelerator, funding, or stage data applies; revenue shown is Amazon's whole AWS segment for FY2024, not a figure specific to Lambda MicroVMs, which was announced in 2025/2026 and has no standalone financials disclosed.
